sempre.subtexto: Charging for data export is what makes a customer hesitate to sign up.

administracao.porque: Users, roles, permissions and company settings.

auditoria.porque: A log with previous and new values, which cannot be edited.

mayra.porque: The read layer comes with every plan.

exportar.porque: Always, and in an open format. We never charge to leave.

complementos.subtexto: An add-on is not a withheld capability. It is another place to work, or usage with a real variable cost.

loja_adicional.descricao: Beyond the stores included in the plan, per store.
loja_adicional.porque: Another counter, another till, another team.

pacote_mayra.descricao: Adds 5,000 calls to the plan's monthly limit.
pacote_mayra.porque: Usage with a real marginal cost.

mudar_plano.r: Yes. You are only charged the difference for the remaining days. When downgrading, the amount is kept as credit for the next cycle.

passar_limite.p: What happens if I exceed the limit of stores or users?
passar_limite.r: We warn you before the limit, with the tier that solves it. Once you reach the limit you can no longer create new stores or users — the existing ones keep working.

deixar_pagar.r: First a warning, then read-only access, then suspension. Data is never deleted, and the full export is always available.

iva.r: No. VAT is added at the statutory rate in force in Mozambique.

servidores.p: Do I need to install servers?
servidores.r: No. It is a cloud service. There is an on-premises option for those who require it — in that case pricing is by quotation.

fecho.titulo: Want to see this with your own store's data?
fecho.texto: Half an hour, no commitment. We show the whole chain closing with one of your products.
